# FFmpeg commands for Reels and TikTok: 9:16 crop, captions, music

**Raw footage, an SRT and a music track become a 1080×1920 MP4 with burned-in captions, trims, joins and ducked music.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_caf5441b3466.webp" alt="Before and after: a 16:9 talking-head clip of a woman at a podcast desk and the same take cropped to 9:16 for Reels with bold white captions burned in." width="480"></p>

Short-form FFmpeg cookbook: copyable commands for Reels. Turns raw footage into a 1080×1920 9:16 MP4 for Reels, TikTok and Shorts with burned-in captions (SRT or ASS), trims and joins clips, and lays music under the voice with ducking. Every command was run on test media. Free and local; works in Claude Code, Codex and Grok, or on the varg ffmpeg tool (credits) when the agent has no shell. Use when the user wants to crop to vertical, burn subtitles, cut or join clips, or add background music with FFmpeg. NOT for animated word-by-word captions (use Remotion or HyperFrames caption skills) or for choosing an editing service (use varg-video-editing).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill short-form-ffmpeg-cookbook                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills short-form-ffmpeg-cookbook --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Crop interview.mp4 to 9:16 and burn in subs.srt for Reels"
- "Join clip1.mp4 and clip2.mp4, which have different sizes, into one vertical video at 30 fps"
- "Put music.mp3 under my voice in vlog.mp4 and duck it while I talk"
